safety_assault_protection_002.evidence: A Teacher who is the victim of an act of violence and who sustains disability on the job and acting within the course and scope of his/her duties shall be allowed leave with pay in accordance with workers compensation law and provisions

safety_student_discipline_003.evidence: 18.1.6. If a student conducts himself/herself in such a manner that seriously impedes learning for himself/herself and other students, or if the safety of himself/herself, other students, or the Teacher is seriously threatened, a Teacher shall be free to send or escort the student to the Supervisor's office

safety_remove_student_004.evidence: 18.1.6. ... a Teacher shall be free to send or escort the student to the Supervisor's office, or to send for the Supervisor or his/her designee.

safety_emergency_closure_005.evidence: 23.5.1. DCPS shall announce any emergency closing via the DCPS website at the earliest possible time.
